rationale: itnet_v2-claude-agentic: itnet_k=1, unet_c=32, itnet_alpha_init=0.001, residual_learning=False, pretrain_lr=0.00025, pretrain_epochs=15, pretrain_patience=15, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=2400, val_n=200, seed=42, rationale=ITER-13 (v3 sentinel gate, normal QOS, strict serial, 20-min). SIX-BOX (VERIFIED via DONE.<jobid> sentinel + obs): iter-6 c32/n2400/lr2.5e-4/alpha0.0026 hr0.8768=BEST; iter-12 c32/n2400/lr5e-4 hr0.8504 (lr 2x HURT -0.026 -> lr=2.5e-4 is better, reverted). (2) FAILURE MODE: lr-up degraded the denoiser; capacity>c32 times out at n2400; data capped at 2400. Remaining cheap training knob at the c32/n2400 champion: itnet_alpha_init (the single k=1 DC-step strength), fixed at 0.0026 all along and untested. The learned alpha settled tiny (~0.0014) so the DC step is near-vestigial; a smaller alpha_init tests whether an even-milder DC step (closer to pure denoiser) helps. (3) ONE KNOB vs iter-6 (c32/n2400/lr2.5e-4): itnet_alpha_init 0.0026 -> 0.001. Hold c=32, n=2400, k=1, lr=2.5e-4, ep=15, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42. (4) HYPOTHESIS: if alpha_init 0.0026->0.001, hr rises above 0.8768 because a milder DC step corrupts the strong pretrained denoiser recon less (k=2/k=4 collapse showed DC hurts on sparse breast; smaller alpha = gentler). FALSIFIER: hr <= ~0.877 => alpha near-optimal/vestigial; iter-14 does seed replicates of the iter-6 champion for mean+/-std. (5) BUDGET: identical to iter-6 (c32/n2400, fits) -- only alpha changes. (6) STRICT one-at-a-time; rm DONE.* before dispatch; confirm via ssh cat DONE.<jobid>.
